description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 1990/23 of 27.06.2016-Regulations
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically amending previous regulations published in an earlier gazette. The content involves legal/regulatory matters - amending and repealing sections of existing regulations and specifying when the amended regulations come into force. While a minister's name appears in the signature block, this is standard for regulatory gazettes and the core content is purely regulatory amendment, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
